verdict.rationale: Manufact ships a CLI for local dev, deploy, and management "without leaving the terminal" (manufact-docs-15/16/26) and explicitly supports API keys for "programmatic access ... from the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts" (manufact-docs-17), plus automatic deploys triggered by git pushes (manufact-docs-24). This is solid evidence of headless/scriptable automation potential.  Missing for 10: an explicit CI pipeline example/tutorial (e.g., GitHub Actions config), documentation of non-interactive/headless CLI flags, and independent confirmation that the CLI/API keys are actually used successfully in CI by real users.
